findings.title: Kiosk catalogue 'recovered' state is UNPROVEN — artifact shows a perpetual loading spinner, not a recovered product grid; assertion passed on an always-present shell element
findings.evidence: The screenshot labelled 'recovered' visually shows the loading spinner block 'Chargement du menu…' (kiosk-catalogue-loading, role=status). DOM confirms: the ACTIVE rendered block is class="kiosk-catalogue-loading" data-testid="kiosk-categories-loading" (1 live node); kiosk-catalogue-error exists ONLY as commented <!--v-if--> placeholders (loadError correctly reset to false at KioskCategoriesComponent.vue:484); there are 0 data-testid="kiosk-product" nodes and kiosk-categories-products is NOT in the visible content. O1-02.network.json records only GET /api/login -> 401 (no successful menu refetch is recorded, though note network.json only logs status>=400 / slow, so a 200 would be invisible). The spec asserted `expect(recovered || stillRoot ...).toBeTruthy()` (spec line 165) where stillRoot = kiosk-categories-root.isVisible() — the root is ALWAYS mounted, so the recovery assertion is satisfied by a shell element regardless of whether products ever render. The proof-of-recovery image therefore proves nothing.
findings.verified: Read O1-02 PNG (spinner visible); grep O1-02.dom.html confirmed 1 live kiosk-catalogue-loading node + 0 kiosk-product nodes; read KioskCategoriesComponent.vue:65-86,483-496 (loading=Vuex kioskMenu/loading getter, loadError reset at 484, retry @click=loadCatalogue).
findings.fix_hint: Product code path is correct (the spinner IS legitimate non-blank degradation, role=status). The TEST is weak: O-1 snaps O1-02 immediately after errorBlock.toBeHidden() while the unrouted refetch is still in flight. Tighten by awaiting a real product/category node (e.g. await page.locator('[data-testid="kiosk-categories-products"] :first-child, .kiosk-product-card').first().waitFor()) OR await the loading spinner hidden BEFORE snapping; and replace the `recovered || stillRoot` OR with a positive content assertion. Until then 'recovery recovers' is asserted but not evidenced.

findings.title: Kiosk network-error screen artifact is MISLEADING — the captured PNG shows the boot overlay ('Démarrage en cours…') fully covering the error screen; toBeVisible() passed on the CTA layout box behind an opaque overlay
findings.evidence: Spec O-2 asserts kiosk-error-network-cta-retry / -cta-staff are toBeVisible() and the title carries real copy. DOM confirms all three testids ARE present and title = 'Connexion perdue' (real copy, no Label.X). BUT the PNG visually shows the kiosk-init-overlay spinner 'Démarrage en cours…' — the DOM still contains 'Démarrage en cours' + 2 kiosk-init-overlay/kiosk-boot markers. Playwright toBeVisible() only checks non-zero box + not display:none, so it saw the error CTAs in the layout UNDERNEATH the opaque boot overlay and passed, while the rendered pixels show a boot spinner — the exact 'blank/shell passed, screen shows something else' trap Wave O exists to catch.
findings.verified: Read O2-01 PNG (boot overlay spinner); grep O2-01.dom.html: kiosk-error-network-cta-retry=1, -cta-staff=1, -title=1, title text 'Connexion perdue', 'Démarrage en cours'=1, kiosk-init-overlay/kiosk-boot=2. Read KioskAppComponent.vue:35,221,326,511-536 — overlay v-if=branchLoading; branchLoading defaults true on (re)mount; loadBranch() (called in mounted) sets branchLoading=false in EVERY branch (lines 521/529/536), with NO gating on any fetch the /kiosk/error/network route skips. O-2 reaches the route via full page.goto (reload) which re-inits the SPA and re-raises branchLoading; the snapshot was taken before loadBranchList resolved.
findings.fix_hint: NOT a hang (overlay always clears once loadBranchList resolves — kiosk-login was 201 in O2-01.network). It is timing: O-2 does page.goto('/kiosk/error/network') then snaps without waiting for the overlay to clear. O-1 already guards this (spec line 136: waitFor('.kiosk-init-overlay', hidden)); O-2 is MISSING the same guard. Add `await page.locator('.kiosk-init-overlay').waitFor({state:'hidden'})` (and/or assert kiosk-error-network-title visible/inViewport) before snap so the artifact actually depicts the error screen the test validates.

findings.title: POS forced-401 re-auth lands on the CUSTOMER storefront login ('Connexion Invité' / 'Inscription'), not an admin/POS re-auth surface
findings.evidence: O4-02 PNG shows the public storefront login card ('Bon Retour', 'Connexion Invité', 'Inscription', nav Accueil/Menu/Offres, <title>Le Cayenne</title>). DOM markers: guest-login=1, 'Connexion invit'=1, 'Bon retour'=1, Accueil. The plan's KEY ASSERTION ('session timeout forces VISIBLE re-auth, no silent 401') IS satisfied — the redirect happened, #formEmail renders. But a POS operator whose session expires mid-shift is dumped onto the consumer-facing storefront with a 'Connexion Invité' (guest) CTA rather than a staff/POS login, which does not route back to /admin/pos after re-auth.
findings.verified: Read O4-02 PNG; grep O4-02.dom.html: id=formEmail=1, guest-login=1, Bon retour / Connexion invit present, <title>Le Cayenne</title>; pos-app.js redirect target is /login (per spec header O-4, pos-app.js:54-63).
findings.fix_hint: UX-only (not blocking). pos-app.js 401 interceptor redirects to '/login' (the public storefront) instead of an admin/POS login. Consider redirecting POS 401s to the admin login route so the operator re-auths into the register, not the customer storefront. Disclose; do not loop.

findings.title: POS 401 logout teardown emits 4 uncaught pageerror AxiosError 401 + a collateral burst of 401s (users/address/2 x3, country-code, frontend/order, cash-drawer)
findings.evidence: After the injected 401 on /api/admin/item, the interceptor fired POST /api/auth/logout -> 200, then a burst of in-flight POS requests 401'd: /api/frontend/order, /api/admin/pos/cash-drawer/sessions/current, /api/admin/country-code/show/FRA, and /api/admin/users/address/2 THREE times (retry-loop smell). Four of these surfaced as level='pageerror' 'Request failed with status code 401' (uncaught promise rejections). Per Reviewer Protocol category 9 these are app-level uncaught errors; the stack's deepest frame is vendor.js (axios settle) but the rejection is NOT handled by the app. Transient logout-teardown noise, but worth honest classification (not silently allowlisted as 'vendor noise').
findings.verified: Read O4-02.console.json (4 pageerror entries) + O4-02.network.json (logout 200 then 7x 401 incl. users/address/2 x3). Stacks: AxiosError at settle (vendor.js).
findings.fix_hint: Non-blocking. During the 401->logout->redirect window, in-flight POS XHRs reject uncaught. Add a catch/abort on the pending request set when the 401 handler initiates the redirect (or cancel the axios queue on logout) so no uncaught pageerror surfaces. The triple users/address/2 401 suggests an unguarded retry — verify it isn't a tight loop.

findings.title: Honest-scope disclosure: GATED states (ConnectionStatusBanner offline/transient, KDS .kds-banner--error, OSS 'connection lost') are documented-not-asserted; AUDIT_PLAN Wave O lists 9 states, spec exercises 4 surfaces
findings.evidence: Spec header (lines 30-42) honestly documents that ConnectionStatusBanner is WS-state/poll-driven (not page.route-triggerable) AND mounted suppress-transient on every surface AND isDevEnv-hidden, so it CANNOT render under route interception; KDS/OSS connection-lost banners are likewise WS/poll-driven. These plan-listed states (kiosk offline banner, OSS no-update->'connection lost', KDS connection-lost banner, admin idle>session, POS payment-device timeout) are therefore NOT captured. This is disclosed, not faked — but it means Wave O's coverage of the plan's 9 enumerated states is partial (4 surfaces: kiosk catalogue fail+recover, kiosk error route, POS skeleton, POS 401). Flagged P3 for honest coverage tracking, not as a defect.
findings.verified: Read spec lines 30-46 (GATED disclosure) + AUDIT_PLAN.md:173-176 (9 enumerated states). The author's note that ConnectionStatusBanner is dev-suppressed/gated is corroborated by the suppress-transient mounts cited and is OK.
findings.fix_hint: Info only. To close the gated states later, drive them through their real trigger: kill/restart soketi to flip wsService WS_STATE (ConnectionStatusBanner), or freeze the KDS/OSS poll source, rather than page.route (which cannot reach WS-state). Not required for V1 convergence.
